verdict.rationale: MailerSend's own docs say it personalizes content with merge fields and conditional logic, and it offers a template management API with create, fetch, update and delete. The evidence does not name or document a templating language, and nothing shows the rest of the story. Missing for 10: loop support, documented templating-language syntax reference, a template preview or test-render capability, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can personalize emails with a documented templating language — merge fields, conditionals, loops — and preview or test-render a template before sending

citations.quote: Personalize content with merge fields and conditional logic.
Create, fetch, update, and delete single templates or a list of templates.
